guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract – Mid West Shropshire
guard_streams.write_limit: Terminated and replacement contract arrangements are procurement status and cannot prove current serviceability for selected parcels.

facts.detail: The page was published on 10 April 2024.
The page was last updated on 10 October 2025.
Voneus is no longer delivering the original contract.
BDUK and Voneus mutually agreed to terminate the contract.
BDUK moved to arrange alternative supplier plans.
Voneus had not received public funding for the contract.
A replacement contract change was agreed in October 2025.
Openreach became the replacement route.
The area was included within call-off three.
Call-off three also covers other parts of Shropshire.

guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract – Dorset and South Somerset
guard_streams.write_limit: Awarded contract scope is subject to detailed planning and technical change and cannot establish live selected-parcel service.

facts.detail: The contract page was published on 10 April 2024.
Wessex Internet is the awarded supplier.
The contract targets around 21,400 premises.
The contract value is £33.5 million.
The contract was signed in March 2024.
Dorset Council is listed as collaborating on delivery.
Preparatory work includes trenching, duct and fibre installation.
A connection can be requested only after the network is built.
The premises list is subject to planning and technical change.
Further premises detail is published through BDUK transparency data.

guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract – South Wiltshire
guard_streams.write_limit: Contracted premises and dates are procurement plans subject to detailed planning and technical change, not current parcel availability.

facts.detail: The contract page was published on 10 April 2024.
Wessex Internet is the awarded supplier.
The contract targets around 14,500 premises.
The contract value is £18.8 million.
The contract was signed in March 2024.
Wiltshire Council is listed as collaborating on delivery.
The first premises were anticipated to gain access by the end of 2024.
A service can be requested after the network has been built.
The premises list is subject to planning and technical change.
Further premises detail is published through BDUK transparency data.
